Jordan P: Quick sync -- partner wants us to host a community build + allow an SI to publish an optimized fork AND allow downloads to enterprise customers. Need concrete onboarding controls.
Asha (Marketplace): Summary of asks: host vanilla, host quantized, list SI fork as separate SKU, allow enterprise customers to download. Questions: can we host community artifacts? how to reflect in UI?
Liam (Legal): Short answer: hosting community-licensed artifacts is OK only if license permits commercial hosting. Must collect `spdx_id` and `consent_rehost` checkbox. Downloads require explicit `consent_download` and export vetting. If downloads are allowed for resell, require indemnity.
Tao (HW): For HW bundles, we need `hw_bundle_id`, `hw_rev` and a perf CSV. SI fork SKUs must include `perf_profile` so customers see expected throughput for that SKU.
Rhea (Ops): Ops requirements: signed `manifest.json` with fields: `vendor`, `model`, `spdx_id`, `sha256`, `build_tag`, `consent_rehost`, `consent_download`, `export_flags`, `modification_level`. On ingest we validate signature and sha256. If `export_flags` != "unrestricted" we auto-block regions.
Jordan P: Good. UI asks: show two chips: "Hosted" vs "Link-only" and a provenance pill [Upstream | Partner build | SI fork]. For downloads show badge "Downloadable" with tooltip listing `consent_download` & `download_license` (internal-only | resell-ok).
Asha (Marketplace): SKU suggestion to encode lineage and bundle: `vendor.model.build.lineage.region.bundle` e.g., `sable-aurora-13b-quant-si-us-west-hw1`. Keeps things unique for billing and search.
Liam (Legal): Draft clause for onboarding (starter): "Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to host and distribute the specified build(s) where `consent_rehost` is true. Downloads permitted only if `consent_download` is true and subject to export controls and `download_license`. Redistribution by downstream parties requires explicit resell permission and indemnity."
Tao (HW): Can we also require `allowed_derivatives` (none|optimizations|fork) in manifest to avoid surprises when SI does heavy surgery?
Rhea (Ops): Yes. We'll enforce `allowed_derivatives`. If SI tries to register a fork beyond allowed level, creation is blocked and #partnerships is notified. NotifierBot: Rule created: fork.registration.attempt -> notify #partnerships with {sku, reason}.
Jordan P: Action items: Liam finalize clause by Tue COB; Asha prototype UI chips + SKU parser by Wed; Rhea implement manifest validator + webhook by next Mon; Tao provide 2 HW bundle samples with perf_profile by Wed.
Asha (Marketplace): UX note: search should de-duplicate by canonical model, but allow users to show all SKUs. In analytics we want to surface per-SKU revenue splits if present.
Liam (Legal): Add machine-readable `license_spdx` to manifest and require `consent_rehost` for any hosted artifact that is not clearly permissive.
Rhea (Ops): We'll log downloads with partner and customer IDs for audit trails. If `download_license` == "resell-ok" we route to manual review in #partnerships.
Jordan P: OK team, consensus reached. I'll open partnership-ticket-10599 with the checklist and link to this thread. Please drop sample manifests for testing. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
NotifierBot: Saved note partnership-ticket-10599 by Jordan P at 3198765500."
